$comment: Official sources per country, read by harvest.py. A host is official when it is, or is a subdomain of, a listed domain, or matches a pattern. Official pages are re-checked weekly and reported by `harvest.py changes`; their domains are allowlisted by `harvest.py sync`. `watch` pages are harvested even when no profile cites them yet. `access` records what the harvest saw, with the date. See docs/HARVEST.md.
